# F2-07 — Architecture-neutral outside review

Reviewed 2026-09-19 · frozen base `8f7eae1780540f422896e105ccfe0bdb602ca548` · proposed repairs only.

## Executive assessment

**Verdict — SCOPED; the package is not ready for an unconditional full build or operational admission.** It is a substantial, unusually explicit specification, with useful separation of duties, authority, evidence and uncertainty. B01 can be bounded as kernel construction after the founder lifts the hold and the affected contract decisions are frozen; this review does not lift that hold. Several domain transitions remain deliberately unresolved, and selected generated criteria disagree with their subject contracts. Whether the system delivers whole-company value within sustainable human effort remains unmeasured. This review adds an OpenAI-family challenge to the historical Claude-family work; it is neither complete semantic acceptance of every source item nor runtime assurance.

**If changing one thing:** make admission to each construction/operating scope depend on a demonstrably executable, useful end-to-end case, with the exact relevant unresolved criteria and human prerequisites listed. Pair the earliest internal case with the existing S0 comparator before funding broad construction. Preserve the complete-company target; distinguish an early discriminator from a production release or a smaller final mandate.

Navigation: [scope and evidence](#scope-and-evidence), [reconstruction](#reconstruction-and-responsibilities), [alternatives](#consequential-alternatives), [first release](#minimum-first-release), [founder decisions](#founder-decision-packet), [dimensions](#independent-quality-dimensions), [review limitations](#review-limitations). Findings, independent verifications, chapter-ordered repairs and exhaustive source indexes follow.

## Reconstruction and responsibilities

The phase-0 map below was written before dispatch. In the final interpretation, **intended** company outcomes, **documented** contracts, **implemented** repository utilities and **observed** tool results remain separate.

The system carries a company outcome through an admitted case and bounded production, checks the exact effect under current authority, captures evidence, obtains scoped acceptance, and maintains surviving duties after task completion. C01–C09 are logical responsibilities; no evidence requires nine agents, services or machines.

| Component | Intended owned boundary | Input → output; material failure path |
|---|---|---|
| C01 Direction | Endorsed intent, decisions, mandates and responsibility | Authenticated instruction → versioned commitment; disputed authority stays unresolved |
| C02 Scheduling | Cases, dependencies, leases, budgets and waiting | Due work → bounded WorkOrder; missing fit/capacity parks with custody |
| C03 Production | Actual artifacts and domain performance | Scoped work/context → output and attempts; cannot independently accept itself |
| C04 Authority | Current class gates, reservations and exact release | Frozen proposed effect → release/deny/unknown; ambiguous effects retain holds |
| C05 Context | Delivered ancestry, authorization, freshness and deletion | Authorized request → manifest and constrained inputs; invalidated sources stop dependent use |
| C06 Acceptance | Observation, methods, calibration and judgments | Evidence → scoped judgment with uncertainty; unsupported evidence cannot become success |
| C07 People | Actual mandates, professionals, remedies and continuity | Decision/duty → accepted human performance or explicit incapacity |
| C08 Recovery | Witness/frontier, restore, restriction and successor access | Failure → contained, reconciled state; old restored grants cannot silently revive |
| C09 Interfaces | Permission-filtered projections and actions | Authoritative state → account/decision/terminal surfaces; stale/partial state must be visible |

The principal flows are distinct: **information** through C05 manifests; **control** through C02 procedures; **authority** through C04 and legitimate human mandates; **evidence** from captured attempts through C06; **failure** into preserved uncertainty, holds, continuity and remedy. A receipt is not delivery; delivery is not acceptance; acceptance is not legal discharge.

Stakeholders include the founder, co-owners if any, customers, suppliers, contractors/employees, professionals, independent custodians, grievance recipients, successors and affected third parties. External dependencies include native model providers, search/mail/public/payment/bookkeeping interfaces, identity/key infrastructure, network/time/storage roots and real human availability. The principal, jurisdiction, offer, staffing and workload are not selected here. The local timezone is not evidence of legal nexus.

## Consequential alternatives

These are evaluation options, not authorization to change the architecture.

| Choice | Current option | Meaningful alternative | Fit, costs, risks and discriminating evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Company coordination | S1 common authority, structured cases and procedures | S0 human-directed native tools with explicit duty/effect/evidence records | S1 may reduce repeated coordination but adds schema/operating maintenance; S0 reduces machinery but adds human transcription, review and absence risk. Compare equal useful duties, errors, total labor, capacity and closure cost. Neither is shown cheaper overall |
| Responsibility boundaries | Common release/control authority | Federated domain systems with reconciled commitments | Federation can preserve native expertise and replacement independence; it adds cross-domain inconsistency and reconciliation risk. Test an offer spanning payment, delivery and support, including outage and disputed ownership |
| Discovery | Scheduled/protected inquiry within S1 | Charter-based compulsory inquiry rights (C2) | C2 may surface neglected opportunities; it consumes capacity and creates arbitration duties. Compare own-rights conformance separately from business outcomes; do not award rights or ontology by resemblance |
| Model work | Temporary instances loading versioned procedures | Stable templates, or genuinely persistent specialists where continuity is independently useful | Persona labels alone do not establish competence; repeated profiles do not establish benefits from persistent identity/memory. Compare equal tools/context/compute, task outcomes, handoff loss, privacy and maintenance; permit either result |
| Release admission | Conjoined consequence classes and protected evidence | Fixed capability floors with narrow manual approval/release routes | Simpler route may fit a bounded low-exposure scope. It must preserve rare high-consequence gates, unknown dimensions and cumulative duties; frequency alone cannot justify removing protection |
| Context/acceptance | Loader-recorded delivery and preproduction criteria | Larger persistent context plus independently captured acceptance | Current design improves influence traceability but costs assembly/checkpoints and can freeze poor criteria. Test omissions, compaction, late changes, false refusal and joint false acceptance; require a controlled criteria-amendment/re-admission path |
| Standing duties | Named holders, alternates and reservations | Contracted external service or fewer combined roles with disclosed conflicts | All need actual authority, availability, compensation and independent grievance routes. A record is not staffing. Compare missed deadlines and human hours; combine roles only where independence requirements permit |
| Deployment | Selected separated Linux/Pg/witness topology | Admitted simpler VPS/managed-service/manual profile | Different infrastructure can reduce some maintenance but must match the chosen trust/recovery claim. No purchase or migration recommendation without measured load, custody evidence and actual quotes |

The no-change option is legitimate for sound boundaries: preserve separation of task completion from surviving obligations; conservative unknown-effect reconciliation; actual professional standing; scoped context; and protected change. Do not add a roster, queue product, microservice or new record merely because a reviewer can name one.

## Minimum first release

**Existing decision:** 08 §7 requires B00–B10 before operating use, with B11 continuing acceptance. A reviewer cannot silently skip B08/B09 or call partial capability construction “the complete system.”

**Optional design proposal:** before broad construction, compare one internal research-to-decision case against S0. Use existing public/authorized material, no customer contact, payment, publication or new external commitment. Success means an actual founder decision supported by usable evidence and an honest account within an agreed attention/cost limit—not merely a passed workflow.

Core case capabilities: CAP-01 (intent), CAP-03/05 (opportunity/market research), CAP-06 (strategy), CAP-11 (quality), CAP-32 (knowledge), CAP-44 (account), CAP-45 (capacity). Supporting duties use narrow portions of CAP-22/23 (privacy/security), CAP-27 (actual collaboration), CAP-31/36/37 (incident/pause/recovery), CAP-43 (attention); CAP-40 records preparatory standing without pretending a trading company is admitted. CAP-04 enters only when the case actually involves customer research and its prerequisites are satisfied.

All nine logical responsibilities remain visible, but people and existing utilities may perform them. C01/C07 can be explicit accepted human assignments; C02 a bounded case list; C03 one admitted production route; C04 the narrow existing authority boundary; C05 a captured source manifest; C06 independent artifact/evidence check; C08 a tested recovery route proportionate to this internal work; C09 one account and intervention surface. This is not a requirement for nine deployed services.

Minimum record families: Principal/IdentityBinding, IntentVersion, Mandate/ResponsibilityAssignment, Case/WorkOrder, source/context manifest, ArtifactVersion/AttemptReport, Observation/EvidenceJudgment, capacity/allowance, Continuation and surviving-duty records. Effect/release/witness records become necessary wherever the case actually makes the corresponding consequence or durability claim. Required schema closure must be computed for that scope, not guessed from this list.

Can remain dormant for this first case: branding/content campaigns, sales/pricing/payment/books, public deployment, partnership/hiring, physical delivery, scaling and automated system improvement. Their duties cannot be omitted once the offer activates them. Paid-service first-release proposals from CFO/customer lanes are materially different: they require formation, agreement, delivery, support, treasury, close, privacy, grievance, refund and continuity paths. Preserve that difference.

**Stages:** under the unchanged plan, follow B00–B10. An earlier internal comparison requires an explicit amendment distinguishing local conformance, internal useful work and consequential operational admission; it does not waive the founder hold, account admission or the final whole-company objective.

## Economics and capacity

The package's **$875.55/month** is a dated scenario estimate including domains, not a current verified quote or budget. It excludes actual tax/FX, professional and custodian engagements, founder/admin labor, payment fees and workload variance. The historical **$399** bookkeeping example is jurisdiction/eligibility limited. No such service was selected, contacted or purchased.

At 30 *intake* cases/month, the arithmetic allocation is $29.19 per intake case before exclusions. If only 15 cases produce an accepted useful outcome, that same fixed subtotal is $58.37 per accepted case. Rejected/abandoned work and surviving duties stay in the denominator/cost ledger. Neither value is a forecast.

A transparent sensitivity worksheet can start with **assumptions, not measurements**:

| Scenario | Native launches/case | Launches/30 cases | Founder case minutes | Founder case hours/month |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Illustrative low | 2 | 60 | 15 | 7.5 |
| Illustrative central | 6 | 180 | 45 | 22.5 |
| Illustrative high | 15 | 450 | 120 | 60 |

Replace these hypotheses with observed case mix. Provider-internal subcalls may be unknowable; a launch is not an API-call count or quota fraction. Separate paid search/mail/payment/reconciliation calls. Add the package's assumed **6–12 monthly operations hours**, incident time, actual professional/custodian quotes, and each person's accepted rate/opportunity cost. Monthly cost is fixed payable expenses + observed variable calls/fees + human hours × applicable rates + continuing/closure obligations. Reserved funds, realized expense and contingent exposure are different quantities.

Compare S1, admitted VPS and S0 at equal duties and guarantees. Do not combine EUR/USD without a dated rate. Idle cost includes continuing hosts, custody, retention, patching and due work even with no launches. Subscription access is not unlimited capacity; no silent paid fallback is permitted. Actual account entitlement and billing-mode observation remain unknown.

### Legal, privacy and professional questions

Before each actual dependent activity, establish the acting principal and the activity/location/audience/data nexus; identify who has authority and which qualified professional determinations are required. Separate data processing/contact from first payment. Determine data categories, permitted purposes/recipients, retention/deletion exceptions, cross-border/provider arrangements, IP/licensing, human employment/contractor duties, accessibility obligations, grievance/redress and succession/insurance coverage for the real scope. Nothing here concludes compliance in an unspecified jurisdiction, creates a professional engagement or authorizes communication.

## Review limitations

This is a broad **scoped outside review**, not an exhaustive semantic audit. Twenty perspectives are model-simulated professional lenses, not twenty qualified humans or stakeholders. Phase-1 reviewers were instructed to form findings without peer outputs; the specific breach below limits that claim. All current models are OpenAI-family; different names do not prove independent errors. Model labels are requested tool selections, not independently attested backend identities. The operator lane self-described as GPT-6 despite a Terra selection; that discrepancy remains unresolved. Different-model verification is recorded at the requested-routing level, not certified backend isolation. Initial verifier tasks bundled several related claims; separate fresh single-claim agents subsequently rechecked the additional claims. One stakeholder verifier accidentally saw peer-review excerpts through an overbroad search; its conclusion was replaced by a fresh verifier restricted to two named specification files. Historical Claude work supplies the other family across rounds, not a contemporaneous independently operated panel.

The distributed-systems lane violated its brief: it read the root phase-0 map (no peer findings were yet in the file) and reran the light validator without bytecode suppression. Five ignored Python cache files were created. Filesystem birth times postdated the review; the orchestrator removed exactly those five new files and their new directory. Its claim of no created files was incorrect. The lane remains a useful finder, but its procedural independence is qualified; its HIGH finding receives a fresh, different-model verifier.

Subagents share a directory and have write-capable tools. Read-only and blind-output boundaries were instructions, not tool-enforced isolation. Their disclosed reading scopes differ; no claim is made that each read the entire 816 KB specification or the full 72 MB package. Some lanes reported omitting the requested handoff question ranges; synthesis supplies missing a–g coverage but cannot retroactively make their process compliant. The source matrix explicitly distinguishes indexed concerns from independently adjudicated ones.

Both published Claude artifact URLs failed through the web tool. Local sources and projection checks were used; no browser/UI equivalence was established. No actual account entitlement, customer result, legal standing, professional availability, runtime predicate interpretation, infrastructure restoration or network-isolation trial was obtained. No full fixture suite ran. Existing studies were rechecked only where a lane identifies a fetched primary source; other research remains historically sourced rather than independently revalidated.

Local Codex 0.154.0 help lists the proposed core flags. Help emitted a sandbox warning about creating PATH aliases; it still exited successfully. Current official [non-interactive documentation](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/non-interactive-mode) supports config/rules suppression, and [permissions documentation](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/permissions) distinguishes local command permissions from hosted search, connectors, MCP and client traffic. Those checks establish neither exact combined-profile behavior nor account admission. No authenticated model invocation was launched for profile testing.

### Review-of-review

Avoid architecture bias: count useful outcomes and consequences, not agents/components. Avoid automation bias: an accepted judgment and a human signature can both be wrong. Avoid complexity bias: retain protective machinery when its consequence warrants it; require evidence before adding records or deleting rare-event protections. Avoid confirmation bias: preserve counterevidence, narrowed severity and dropped unsafe-pass claims. Avoid evaluator overreach: findings name their stage and evidence; recommendations do not lift holds or settle founder choices. Avoid coverage inflation: a resolving link, “answered” row, declared fixture or separate model name is not independent acceptance.

## Ranked challenges and dispositions

**Retained:** 20 MEDIUM, 7 HIGH, 1 BLOCKER. **Dropped:** 9. All 37 records remain in [the JSONL findings](F2-07-outside-findings.jsonl). Dropped records use LOW solely to satisfy the handoff’s severity enum; they are excluded from retained severity totals. Twenty-four retained records are CONFIRMED and four are PLAUSIBLE. Duplicates are preserved as perspectives, not counted as independent evidence or separate repair work.

Ranking combines consequence and dependency, not merely numerical severity. The deletion-entry BLOCKER is specific to accepting that lifecycle; it does not mean all B01 construction is impossible.

1. **Make the effect winner atomic with release/send authorization** — [F7-distributed-01](#f7-distributed-01), HIGH. Bind existing EffectIdentity winner comparison/CAS and claim in one transaction; distinct operations must not each authorize the same effect.
2. **Make the deletion lifecycle enterable** — [F7-database-01](#f7-database-01), BLOCKER. Replace the unresolved determined criterion with sourced scoped evidence semantics; preserve denial on missing evidence.
3. **Define complete deletion proof** — [F7-database-02](#f7-database-02), HIGH. Specify cross-revision receipt applicability, inventory/frontier coverage and clean versus residual completion; include F7-privacy-01.
4. **Restore journal-specific acceptance meaning** — [F7-accountant-01](#f7-accountant-01), HIGH. Replace resource-reservation meaning with currency/exponent balance, source/treatment and unreconciled-item criteria; do not claim an arithmetic bypass was observed.
5. **Bind continuity to the actual joint-loss arrangement** — [F7-insurer-successor-01](#f7-insurer-successor-01), HIGH. Tie accepted/active status to exact successor, surviving funds, triggers and scoped exercise evidence; keep Q012 open.
6. **Cover every surviving duty at closure** — [F7-insurer-successor-02](#f7-insurer-successor-02), HIGH. Join each residual duty to accepted custody, reserved resources and review responsibility; cash snapshots alone do not prove coverage.
7. **Define successful refund completion** — [F7-cfo-01](#f7-cfo-01), HIGH. Supply payment-linked settlement and residual-duty semantics; existing unspecified guard currently denies rather than admits.
8. **Protect the rare high-consequence tail** — [F7-orchestrator-01](#f7-orchestrator-01), HIGH. Make >90% low-class frequency a reopen trigger only; removal requires replacement equivalence for every affected gate.
9. **Bring the value/cost discriminator forward** — [F7-product-02](#f7-product-02), MEDIUM. Name a bounded early integrated workflow checkpoint; combine founder/small-business/economic findings without shrinking the final mandate.
10. **Narrow the evidence behind no-roster and persistence triggers** — [F7-ml-01](#f7-ml-01), MEDIUM. Retain the design provisionally; separate persona prompting, specialist configuration, profile reuse and persistence/memory benefit.

### Disagreements preserved

- Finder claims of refund bypass, missing parking and absent deployment readback were rejected on indirect-contract evidence, not by a vote.
- An initial accounting-time verifier retained a possible explicit-binding gap; a fresh single-claim verifier found no new defect because CashPosition ingestion is not accounting close and IC-BOOKS already requires exact periods. The original allegation is dropped; a concrete close-authorizing counterexample remains a valid falsifier.
- Full-company breadth is endorsed scope. Founder, product and small-business perspectives favor earlier integrated value/cost learning; this does not justify a permanently smaller product or prove that S0 is better.
- No-roster remains a reasonable provisional design choice. Persona prompting evidence and profile concentration cannot settle specialist competence or persistent memory benefit.

4. **03 — company phase meanings** — [F7-accountant-01](#f7-accountant-01). Give JournalBatch.balanced an explicit subject-specific generated criterion requiring journal debit/credit arithmetic by currency/exponent, source/treatment coverage and unresolved-item disposition. Correct meaning/requires and paired controls so unrelated resource-account attestations cannot count.

5. **03 — fulfillment phase meanings; 07 payment adapter** — [F7-cfo-01](#f7-cfo-01). Define exact refund entitlement, amount/currency, operation/provider correlation and sufficient settlement evidence for refunded; preserve pending/unknown effects and duty custody separately. Bind reservation release to the actual settled entitlement, never an acknowledgement or generic case closure.

6. **03 — responsible ending; 11 ClosurePlan** — [F7-insurer-successor-02](#f7-insurer-successor-02). Define residual-duty coverage through existing records or a mapping: each obligation needs accepted continuing custody, review owner/date and adequate reserved capacity for its horizon. Closure validation compares inventory completeness, allocation/availability and review coverage; CashPosition supports but does not replace those bindings.

7. **03 — prerequisite lead times; Q007/Q008** — [F7-legal-02](#f7-legal-02). Replace Q007’s first-payment milestone with the earliest dependent effect minus necessary determination/readiness lead time. Apply Q008 latest responsible start; preserve unrelated preparation.

8. **04 — operator command contract** — [F7-founder-02](#f7-founder-02). In 04 define an outcome-intake action accepting outcome, constraints, exclusions, horizon and optional capability/procedure hints. Return proposed typed Case/WorkOrder references or no_match/budget_exhausted; invoke the existing company.work.request only after resolution. Specify empty-state entry and require endorsement only for new ends or material exposure.

9. **05 — consequence layer §11; AD015** — [F7-orchestrator-01](#f7-orchestrator-01). Replace the >90% removal arm with a reopen-only trigger; remove derivation only after explicit replacement-equivalence evidence covers the higher-consequence residual and every reached gate. Preserve C5 protected approval.

10. **05 — worker evidence §4; AD020 / U8 / R2** — [F7-ml-01](#f7-ml-01). Correct R2/AD020's persona-selection scope; label skill-based specialization allocation a revisable design choice and preserve performance-supported specialist routes. Reframe U8 as configuration reuse/justification-cost evidence; require a matched fresh-versus-persistent comparison before conclusions about identity or memory. Retain current no-roster default provisionally.

11. **05 — header and §13; CAP43 / Q019** — [F7-philosopher-01](#f7-philosopher-01). Reconcile05 header and§13 with Q019's dated resolution; distinguish answered policy from unperformed assessment and clarify CAP43 owner/assessor roles without implying assessment already occurred.

12. **07 — native execution §5; 02 §13** — [F7-operators-01](#f7-operators-01). In 07 §5 explicitly bind managed default_permissions, allowed profile set, resolved profile name and requirements/config digests in the prelaunch attestation. Refuse unexpected profile or legacy-setting fallback. Use the actual pinned-version managed schema rather than an invented CLI selection flag.

13. **07 — capacity §6; Q020/Q021** — [F7-economist-02](#f7-economist-02). Synchronize07§6 and related MD08 references with Q021's adopted shares and 20%-remaining lapse placeholder. Preserve missing minimum/measurement uncertainty, Q022 account inspection and performer/delivery gates; do not require unpublished quota numbers or imply proven throughput.

14. **07 — economics §7 / admission §8; 08 comparator** — [F7-founder-03](#f7-founder-03), [F7-economist-01](#f7-economist-01), [F7-stakeholders-02](#f7-stakeholders-02). Operationalize08§8 using one frozen task population and acceptance criteria: join fixed/amortized and variable cash, actual human time, scarce capacity, all attempts and accepted outcomes; report totals and per-accepted-case values including zero acceptances. Use 30 cases as a review scenario, not an invented requirement. Gate funded scaling on evidence. Include actual service, remedy, human and professional costs before relevant offers; the infrastructure subtotal does not establish affordability.

15. **08 — stage graph §7 and comparator §8** — [F7-founder-01](#f7-founder-01), [F7-product-02](#f7-product-02), [F7-smallbiz-01](#f7-smallbiz-01), [F7-smallbiz-02](#f7-smallbiz-02). Name an early representative workflow checkpoint, outcome/attention/total-cost thresholds, evidence owner and stop/revise consequence, or identify an existing equivalent checkpoint. Preserve full-company scope and B10 operating safeguards. Before substantial deployment-specific construction add the staffability/owner-limit checkpoint, a resource ceiling and explicit continue/resequence/stop consequences. This requires a founder-approved sequencing amendment, not review-authorized implementation.

16. **08 — B01/B02 completion evidence** — [F7-backend-03](#f7-backend-03). Clarify B01 evidence as synthetic receipt/proof fixtures through the future witness interface, carrying no durability claim; require actual witness loss/ack/crash acceptance at B02.

17. **11 — generated DeletionScope determined contract / owning source** — [F7-database-01](#f7-database-01). Specify determined-phase evidence binding for exact scope, purpose, inventory/frontier, restriction epoch, applicable policy/determination, owner, deadline and proof limits; replace the gap with an executable criterion preserving unresolved-on-missing behavior.

18. **12 — interaction determination; 11 generated binding** — [F7-legal-01](#f7-legal-01). Define the determination's exact scope, conclusion, conditions, source/issuer competence and effective interval, linking ProfessionalDetermination only when actual activity requires professional judgment. Make unresolved classes restrictive; test mismatched scope, expiry, outstanding conditions and one valid determination.

## Phase 0 map preserved

The following was written before any perspective was dispatched. Later findings above qualify its reconstruction; it is not retroactive evidence of independent verification.

## Phase 0 — System map recorded before delegation

Review subject: `review/outside-2026-09-19`, clean starting tree `8f7eae1780540f422896e105ccfe0bdb602ca548`. The user's supplied base supersedes the handoff's `1182e9b`. This is a mixed vision, normative specification, machine-contract package and historical review record for “The Company Engine”; it is not an operating company system. Existing repository software supplies historical evidence, not implementation of S1.1. Founder hold and `planning_accepted: false` remain controlling.

The intended result is that a person can direct whole-company work without personally supervising each step, while retaining legitimate authority, competence, accountability and visibility into surviving duties. A case organizes activity; an obligation survives case closure; a proposed external operation is separately authorized and can remain uncertain after execution. Payment, delivery, acceptance and discharge are distinct. Deterministic machinery, bounded model work, people and qualified external providers are alternative performers, selected for the work and consequences.

Nine logical responsibilities divide the design: C01 preserves direction and commitments; C02 schedules cases; C03 produces; C04 controls authority and releases effects; C05 supplies authorized context and validity; C06 captures evidence and judges acceptance; C07 connects real people, mandates and remedies; C08 recovers state and continuity; C09 projects records into operator surfaces. These are neither nine compulsory services nor nine agents. Five precedence layers govern work: consequence classes, declared procedures, standing interests, temporary-worker justification, and standing accountability. A stable roster is not selected; repeatable expertise resides primarily in procedures. Permanent duties still require reachable holders. The absence of a roster is a revisable design decision, not an empirical law.

Information moves through scoped, recorded context; authority moves through grants and protected release checks; evidence moves from observed attempts to separately scoped acceptance; failures preserve holds, uncertain effects and unresolved duties. Native Claude/Codex execution and seven proposed adapters depend on account admission and environment controls that have not been demonstrated. Node/TypeScript and PostgreSQL are proposed construction choices; B00–B11 describe the dependency graph, not completed work.

The principal stakeholders are the founder, customers, suppliers, human performers, professionals, custodians and successors; third-party standing cannot be erased by an internal workflow. Actual jurisdictions, account entitlements, staffing, sustainable attention and measured unit economics remain admission questions. The package's strengths are explicit epistemic limits, alternatives, duty continuity and separation of production from authority. Their practical cost and effectiveness remain hypotheses. Offline structural checks cannot establish runtime enforcement, business value or affordable operation.

Sources inspected before dispatch: `../README.md`; `../state.json` phase, continuation and historical validation records; `../HANDOFF-2026-09-15-after-r8.md`; `../PLANNING-REPORT.md` status, F2 decisions, uncertainty, disposition and discrepancies; `../00-executive-guide.md`; `../02-architecture-selection.md` §3; `../site/explorer/data/README.md` projection schema. Paths here are package-relative descriptions; authoritative citations follow in the completed report. The task-specific handoff supplies this run's stages; the repository's bounded `research-question` playbook is insufficient for this whole-system review.

Review in progress. This initial map is preserved in the final report; findings follow only after independent challenge.

identity.natural_key","on_conflict":"resolve_to_existing_head","creates_second_record":false,"why":"record-registry.json states RESOLVE-OR-CREATE on the EffectIdentity triple (effect_class_id, counterparty_id, payload_digest) and a one-per-key rule on AdmissionRecord, ExhaustionDecision and FieldAuthority, while this command -- the only create path any of the four names -- specified the create path identically to every other record. A registration whose natural key is already allocated RESOLVES to the existing head and returns it: it does not create a second record, and it is not a typed conflict. Without this the registry identity is the surrogate triple, the natural key is three ordinary payload fields, and an implementer picks between a unique-index conflict, a read-then-join and two rows -- three different systems (F6V-02, reviews/F2-06-recheck-02.md)."}},"planned_module":"system/apps/witness","review_status":"Requires further evidence","implementation_status":null,"finding_refs":[]},

{"id":"AD-013","kind":"Decision","architecture_version":"S1.0","date":"2026-09-13","status":"adopted; mechanism decision derived from the selected architecture; revisable by a reviewed ChangeProposal","owner":"orchestrator (decision); canonical contract author (implementation); independent reviewer (recheck)","title":"Performance of a sale is accepted delivery plus discharged or transferred obligations — never payment alone","problem":"G2-01 (d): criterion.SalesAgreement.performed.v1 demanded exactly what accepted demanded; SalesAgreement had no relation to Fulfillment; a paid but undelivered sale could reach performed. \"What evidence constitutes performance of a sale\" was unstated, and the two available inventions (payment settled / delivery accepted) describe different companies.","decision":"SalesAgreement gains /payload/fulfillment_ref → Fulfillment; criterion.SalesAgreement.performed.v1 requires Fulfillment in a delivered/accepted state and every linked Obligation discharged or transferred; payment settlement moves the agreement to accepted or partially-performed, not performed. Requiring Fulfillment delivered and Obligations discharged/transferred makes the prose true.","epistemic_basis":"Decision. The Phase G reviewer classified the gap (d): implementation would otherwise settle it silently.","accepted_design_costs":"Fulfillment must gain a domain lifecycle (G2-05) before any sale can reach performed; a service with no observable delivery event cannot be marked performed by payment alone and must record why. {"id":"AD-014","kind":"Decision","architecture_version":"S1.0","date":"2026-09-13","status":"adopted; mechanism decision derived from the selected architecture; revisable by a reviewed ChangeProposal","owner":"orchestrator (decision); canonical contract author (implementation); independent reviewer (recheck)","title":"Terminating a sales agreement is a closure event; surviving duties live in terminated_with_residuals","problem":"G2-02 (d): the four SalesAgreement:*→terminated edges carried transition_basis only, while every other closure edge in the registry carries due_preserved; there was no terminated_with_residuals state, so terminating a disputed sale with recognized obligations succeeded and asserted closure with nothing having looked.","decision":"All four SalesAgreement:*→terminated edges carry due_preserved; a new terminal state terminated_with_residuals holds the case where the transitive due set is not empty, with an accepted custodian for each residual, matching Commitment:made→ended_with_residuals and CAP-39 closed-with-residuals. terminated asserts that nothing is owed.","alternatives":["Declare termination not a closure event (rejected: would have to explain why Commitment ended, Offer withdrawn and Case abandoned — the same act at another record — all carry due_preserved)","due_preserved without a residuals state (rejected: forces either refusal to terminate while duties survive, or silent closure; the Commitment and CAP-39 precedent is a residuals state with custodians)"],"evidence_and_reasoning":"Consistency of the existing closure-edge set (Commitment, Offer, Case, GrievanceCase, Obligation, Fulfillment, ClosurePlan, Venture); 02 §3 \"an obligation survives that case\"; protocol §Changeability \"old effects or duties cannot disappear\". The reviewer's counterexample (three recognized obligations and an open SupportCase survive a successful terminate) validated at 7ddc066.","epistemic_basis":"Decision. Derived from the adopted S1.0 selection (02-architecture-selection.md §3, §6) and from the consistency of the existing closure-edge set in contracts/record-registry.json; not from new evidence and not from a founder value. The Phase G reviewer classified the gap (d): implementation would otherwise settle it silently.","accepted_design_costs":"Terminating a sale now requires computing the transitive due set at the witnessed frontier and assigning a custodian to each residual; a terminate that cannot do so lands in terminated_with_residuals rather than terminated.","external_exposure_authorized":"None. {"id":"AD-015","kind":"Decision","architecture_version":"S1.1","date":"2026-09-13","status":"adopted for the F2 amendment of 05-work-agents-skills.md; a selection, not complete-plan review, runtime conformance or founder acceptance","owner":"orchestrator under founder directive","title":"Consequence class is the routing axis, and the reached set governs — never a rank","problem":"The F2 round had to pick a routing unit for the work / agents / authority / skills / context / routing layer, and every candidate carried blocking findings that clustered on its own routing unit. R2 F-20 established that there is no single unit of justification: the founder's five criteria predicate on five different objects, and a criterion applied to the wrong unit returns undecidable, which reads as satisfied. The hybrid candidate routed on consequence class but computed one governing class by max() over a rank, and AT-M4-02 showed an action reaching two classes gated by only the higher row — while 02-authority-recovery.md §4 already requires that an action satisfying several classes meet all their gates.","decision":"Consequence class is layer 1 and decides who may act; a declared procedure decides how work runs and what each step may see (layer 2), a typed standing interest decides when work becomes due (layer 3), an existence record decides whether a worker may be created at all (layer 4), and exactly one standing party exists for each duty that outlives the case carrying it (layer 5). When two layers disagree the lower-numbered layer governs. The derivation returns the SET of reached classes and every reached class's gates apply. No total rank exists, no severity score is computed and no seventh class is added, so no monotonicity proof is owed (R-D22). One implementation of the derivation function exists; changing the function, the mapping table, the holder set or a declared floor is a protected control change.","alternatives":["Rank the reached classes and gate on the maximum — the hybrid candidate's construction, which drops gates the fixed boundary already requires (AT-M4-02)","Route on the worker, as the capability-differentiated and chartered candidates do — it makes the routing unit a property of the worker rather than of the work, and inherits that unit's blind spot (R2 F-20)","Route on the declared procedure alone — it decides how work runs and cannot decide who may act on work no procedure covers","Adopt one candidate whole rather than layering the units — every candidate's blockers cluster on its own unit, so adopting one adopts its blind spot","Close the founder's reason list at five, which remains his to do: it makes this design inadmissible on his own gate and is registered as TC-35"],"evidence_and_reasoning":["planning/F2/05-selection-record.md#1-decision","planning/F2/05-selection-record.md#31-from-m4--the-routing-axis-layer-1","planning/F2/05-selection-record.md#51-the-synthesized-rules (R-L1; MD-22 / R-D22)","planning/F2/05-selection-record.md#13-evidence-ledger (rows 1-2: R2 F-21.3, TC-17, AT-M4-02, DIRECTIVE §1.5)","planning/specification/02-authority-recovery.md#4-authentication-principals-and-grant-attenuation","research/F2/cross-lane-comparison.md (R2 F-20: no single unit of justification)","planning/F2/04-attack-consolidation.md (AT-M4-02)"],"epistemic_basis":"Inference on a founder constraint, plus a restatement of a fixed boundary. The reached-set rule is 02 §4 restated rather than changed. The choice of routing axis is an inference from R2 F-20 and from the observed clustering of each candidate's blockers on its own unit; no runtime measured it. The layer precedence ORDER is the selection record's own marked design proposal with no finding behind it (§13, row 70), and it is the load-bearing unevidenced choice here: nothing in this round tests a precedence between routing units, because no candidate had more than one.","accepted_design_costs":["Every action carries a set rather than one class, so gate evaluation is a conjunction over rows and cannot be short-circuited by a comparison","The precedence between layers is unevidenced; if it is wrong, the whole selection is wrong and nothing in this round would have caught it","The added structure is not paid for if more than 90% of admitted actions derive to the two lowest classes, which is this layer's own removal criterion"],"external_exposure_authorized":false,"reversibility":"Repository-local specification remains reversible; operational promises, disclosure and lost data require separate consequence decisions.","reopen_trigger":"Reopen when more than 90% of admitted actions derive to the two lowest classes over a fixed window, or when the derivation and the declared floor agree on every action over a window — then the derivation adds nothing the floor already said and the floor alone survives. Reopen layer 1's release path if the runtime holds no credential at the boundary that can be narrowed: attenuation is then unavailable, the constraint must be enforced by mediation, and that is a different architecture (§11.1.2). Also reopen if the admission authority's concentration measurably misses important work, raises founder labour or obstructs independently capable domains. Origin: F2 Step 5a-ii selection record §1, §11.3.","implementation_evidence":null,"source":"registers/decisions.json#/14","review_status":"Partially addressed","independent_review_note":"Source disposition preserved; no runtime or professional certification inferred. See founder packet, desk checks and findings."},
{"id":"AD-016","kind":"Decision","architecture_version":"S1.1","date":"2026-09-13","status":"adopted for the F2 amendment of 05-work-agents-skills.md; a selection, not complete-plan review, runtime conformance or founder acceptance","owner":"orchestrator under founder directive","title":"The class is computed from records the acting party cannot author, and recomputed at the effect","problem":"A consequence class computed from anything the acting party can author is a boundary that party can move. R4 found tool self-description, command-text matching, instruction scoping, definition-file authority and sandbox verdicts each insufficient as the input to an authority decision (R4 F1, F4, F5, F8, F9, F12; AG-08). Separately, a class computed at admission and never re-checked is a grant checked against bytes that are not the bytes released (AS-M4-02).","decision":"The class derives by one deterministic function from resolved parameters, the destination and egress identity, the selector closure over conflict claims, deletion scopes and open obligations, and the owning capability contract's declared floor — every one a record the acting party cannot author. The class is recomputed inside the ordered release transaction on the frozen bytes; a mismatch PARKS and never resolves downward. ConsequenceDerivation is append-only and written only inside the release path, and its mismatch disposition is writable only by the party owning the park. An executor's grant scope is a proposal right; C04 performs every release. Where a dimension is unresolvable the class resolves to the ceiling of the unresolved dimensions.","alternatives":["Compute the class once at admission and trust it at release — the grant is then checked against bytes that are not the bytes released (AS-M4-02)","Let the acting worker or a model declare its own class, refused because a boundary a party can author is a boundary that party can move (R4 F1, F4, F5, F8, F9, F12)","Resolve a release-time mismatch downward to the lower class, refused: it parks, and a park is a state with an owner rather than a silent continue","Screen a false entry rather than gate on it, refused: a poisoning attack carrying no instruction at all passed a four-stage screen 360 times out of 360 (R1 F-10)"],"evidence_and_reasoning":["planning/F2/05-selection-record.md#51-the-synthesized-rules (R-L1, R-X01)","planning/F2/05-selection-record.md#13-evidence-ledger (rows 3-5: R4 F1, F4, F5, F8, F9, F12, AG-08, AS-M4-02)","planning/F2/05-selection-record.md#24-the-three-findings-most-likely-to-change-what-you-do (R1 F-10, R2 F-09)","research/F2/R4-authority.md","planning/F2/reviews/A-security-adversarial.md (AS-M4-02)","planning/specification/02-authority-recovery.md#4-authentication-principals-and-grant-attenuation"],"epistemic_basis":"Source claim plus specification. The refused inputs are R4's measurements, made elsewhere and not by this project; the recompute-at-release rule takes AS-M4-02 as the gap and is this record's specification as the repair. The one-implementation rule is a direct observation on this repository's own classifier, where two implementations of one risk classification disagreed and it was found during an incident.","accepted_design_costs":["A release transaction carries a second derivation and the cost of freezing the bytes before it","A parked mismatch needs a party who owns the park — a staffing precondition, not a code path","Resolving an unresolvable dimension to its ceiling is deliberately conservative and will refuse some legitimate work; false exclusion is unmeasured everywhere in the corpus (U-12) and this decision adds to it"],"external_exposure_authorized":false,"reversibility":"Repository-local specification remains reversible; operational promises, disclosure and lost data require separate consequence decisions.","reopen_trigger":"Reopen if the runtime holds no credential at the boundary that can be narrowed, because layer 1's release path is then mediation rather than attenuation (§11.1.2). Reopen on a demonstrated class input that only the acting party can supply and for which no non-authorable substitute exists, or if recomputation parks so often that the release path is unusable. Origin: F2 Step 5a-ii selection record §5.1 R-L1.","implementation_evidence":null,"source":"registers/decisions.json#/15","review_status":"Partially addressed","independent_review_note":"Source disposition preserved; no runtime or professional certification inferred. See founder packet, desk checks and findings."},
{"id":"AD-017","kind":"Decision","architecture_version":"S1.1","date":"2026-09-13","status":"adopted for the F2 amendment of 05-work-agents-skills.md; a selection, not complete-plan review, runtime conformance or founder acceptance","owner":"orchestrator under founder directive","title":"A step declares its read set, and the loader delivers and records it","problem":"\"The checker did not read the producer's rationale\" was an assertion in every candidate and a fact in none: the caller claimed its read list and nothing recorded what was actually delivered. R7 §7 and F9 establish that independence of INFLUENCE is the half of verification that is reachable at all, and it is reachable only if delivery is observed rather than claimed. R2 F-03 and R3 F51-F52 add the discriminator: auto-generated multi-agent systems underperformed a single agent at up to ten times the cost while an expert-designed one reached 96.5% against 57.0% on the same diagnostic, and what separates them is whether separation is enforced by construction or only described in prompts.","decision":"WorkflowDefinition and StepExecution gain step_kind ∈ {compute, model, human, professional, effect}, declared_read_set, declared_grants, validator_ref, branch_set and critical_fields — as fields on existing registry records, never as new records. The loader delivers the declared read set and RECORDS what it actually delivered; the caller's claimed read list is not trusted. A guard is a pure function over typed outputs and journal state, and a model's output is an input to a guard and never a jump. The step boundary is the checkpoint and the cost is carried. One effect per effect step, and the step is the idempotency unit. Procedure admission refuses a branch set in which a model-authored value selects between acceptance strengths.","alternatives":["Trust the caller's declared read list — the pre-repair state, an assertion no record can contradict","Blind the checker by instruction in a prompt, refused: separation enforced by construction is the measured discriminator (R2 F-03, R3 F51, F52)","A separate reserved closing-allowance predicate instead of checkpointing every step boundary, which needs a denominator this round establishes does not exist","Let a model step select a branch, refused: a model's output is an input to a guard, and acceptance-strength selection is a guard over journal state and consequence class"],"evidence_and_reasoning":["planning/F2/05-selection-record.md#32-from-m3--the-execution-structure-layer-2","planning/F2/05-selection-record.md#51-the-synthesized-rules (R-L2, R-D19, R-X19)","planning/F2/05-selection-record.md#13-evidence-ledger (rows 7-12: AT §E.2, R7 §7 and F9, R2 F-09, F-18, R3 F29, F30, F41, F44)","planning/specification/06-knowledge-evidence-evaluation.md#2-context-assembly-and-information-loss","research/F2/R7-verification.md","planning/F2/reviews/A-technical.md (AT-M1-03, AT §E.2)"],"epistemic_basis":"Source claim plus inference. The loader-records-delivery rule rests on R7's influence-independence findings and on AT §E.2; the step-boundary checkpoint is AT-M1-03's own second branch taken whole. The five step kinds as an EXHAUSTIVE set is a marked design proposal with no finding behind it (§13, row 9), and its falsifier is one real work item that fits none of them.","accepted_design_costs":["Checkpointing every step boundary carries a real per-step cost, and taking the step model takes its dominant unpriced cost with it: the per-step cacheless launch cost against a long-session arm is unmeasured (U-11), and the expected-launch count per procedure version is the instrument that would price it","Authoring and maintaining declared procedures is layer 2's real cost and is unevaluable in any unit today (U-7)","The loader's record proves what was delivered, not that the delivery was the right set; the provider may edit context after any loader has recorded its inputs, and what one compaction event loses in load-bearing facts is unmeasured (U-4)"],"external_exposure_authorized":false,"reversibility":"Repository-local specification remains reversible; operational promises, disclosure and lost data require separate consequence decisions.","reopen_trigger":"Reopen when a newer model passes every step's declared validator with the step merged into its neighbour or removed — a scaffold's contribution is a function of the generation that motivated it and must be re-ablated when the model changes (§11.3, L2). Reopen the layer's foundation if a defence rests on a mechanism nobody can test. Origin: F2 Step 5a-ii selection record §5.1 R-L2, §11.3.","implementation_evidence":null,"source":"registers/decisions.json#/16","review_status":"Partially addressed","independent_review_note":"Source disposition preserved; no runtime or professional certification inferred. See founder packet, desk checks and findings."},
{"id":"AD-018","kind":"Decision","architecture_version":"S1.1","date":"2026-09-13","status":"adopted for the F2 amendment of 05-work-agents-skills.md; a selection, not complete-plan review, runtime conformance or founder acceptance","owner":"orchestrator under founder directive","title":"Acceptance criteria are authored by the capability owner, frozen before the producing step, and unamendable by the producing path","problem":"AS-X-01 found a fourth unblinded channel into the checker that no research lane named: the acceptance criteria themselves, authored by the producing path. AX had tested the three channels R7 named — the producer's rationale, the producer's preferred conclusion and the shared record — and found them closed in all five candidates, recording no blocking finding on W5. The consolidation recorded the two dispositions as in conflict with no review owning the reconciliation.","decision":"The capability owner authors the acceptance criteria at procedure admission. They are versioned and frozen BEFORE the producing step starts; the producing path may neither author nor amend them, and an amendment between admission and submission is refused by a guard. Fixture F-4 gains a fourth arm in which the criteria are authored by the producing path, reported beside the existing three. W5 is recorded as sufficient on the three tested channels and UNESTABLISHED on the fourth until that arm runs; AX's judgement is not overturned. A check reads only fields the producer could not author, its tie-break inverts to strongest-sufficient, and a checker with no paired clean-case refusal rate resolves unresolved, never pass.","alternatives":["Treat AS-X-01 as non-blocking because the lane that raised it did not own the dimension, refused: a finding's class under protocol §5 is a property of the finding — its trigger, its resulting failure, its affected requirement — and not of which lane noticed it","Pin the criteria inside an immutable procedure only, which is the workflow-first candidate's exemption and does not cover the adaptive and unclassified paths this synthesis also admits","Record W5 as sufficient on the verdict matrix alone, which reports an assurance whose scope is unstated","Author plausible criteria inside the producing path and rely on review to catch a bad one, which is the silent path an implementer would otherwise take"],"evidence_and_reasoning":["planning/F2/05-selection-record.md#63-the-as-x-01--ax-w5-tension-resolved","planning/F2/05-selection-record.md#51-the-synthesized-rules (R-D11 / R-G02, R-X20, R-X14)","planning/F2/05-selection-record.md#13-evidence-ledger (rows 32-34: AM-01, R7 F1, F2, F8, F12, F13, F15, TC-37, FAL-08, FAL-09, AG-15, AS-X-01, G-02)","planning/specification/06-knowledge-evidence-evaluation.md#6-evaluation-contracts-at-every-level","planning/specification/06-knowledge-evidence-evaluation.md#7-cases-trials-independence-and-negative-controls","planning/F2/reviews/A-security-adversarial.md (AS-X-01)","planning/F2/reviews/A-context-evidence.md (AX, W5)"],"epistemic_basis":"Specification closing a blocking finding. The reconciliation of AS-X-01 against AX's W5 is an inference from the acceptance protocol's own classification rule and not a measurement. Whether the fourth channel changes any verification verdict is UNKNOWN until the fourth F-4 arm runs — owner C06, at the first F-4 execution, whenever a runtime exists. Independence of ERROR is not claimed at all: it is unreachable inside one model family and is disclaimed in every acceptance that rests on a same-family checker. R-G02, the one rule this record cites that appears nowhere in the specification (F6A-11, 2026-09-14): the selection record's rule table records R-G02 as \"= R-D11\", and the rule landed under that id at 06-knowledge-evidence-evaluation.md section 7. The ID did not land; the RULE did, and nothing is outstanding behind it.","accepted_design_costs":["A criterion must exist and be frozen before production starts, so a capability owner sits on the critical path of every procedure admission","The fourth F-4 arm is owed and cannot run without a runtime: this decision closes the finding in specification and leaves the measurement open","Joint false acceptance for a same-family producer/checker pair on planted defects is the quantity that decides whether separating the checker buys anything, and nobody has measured it (U-3)"],"external_exposure_authorized":false,"reversibility":"Repository-local specification remains reversible; operational promises, disclosure and lost data require separate consequence decisions.","reopen_trigger":"Reopen on any acceptance recorded as passed where the checker reported no clean-case rate — that must resolve unresolved — and on a rising pass rate as load rises, which is the registered tell that verification is being starved (§11.1.5). Reopen this decision if the fourth F-4 arm shows the criteria channel changes the verdicts. Origin: F2 Step 5a-ii selection record §6.3, §5.1 R-D11.","implementation_evidence":null,"source":"registers/decisions.json#/17","review_status":"Partially addressed","independent_review_note":"Source disposition preserved; no runtime or professional certification inferred. {"id":"AD-019","kind":"Decision","architecture_version":"S1.1","date":"2026-09-13","status":"adopted for the F2 amendment of 05-work-agents-skills.md; a selection, not complete-plan review, runtime conformance or founder acceptance","owner":"orchestrator under founder directive","title":"Relevance is computed by deterministic arming, and no component may prevent an interest arming","problem":"A shared source of truth nobody is forced to read is not a source of truth, and a deferral nobody can see is indistinguishable from an oversight. The subscription-activated candidate is the only one in the round where an item's relevance is computed rather than remembered, and nothing in it stopped a component from suppressing an arming. Its own two blocking findings followed from letting an activation promote what it investigated.","decision":"StandingInterest and the ArmedSet are registered. Preconditions are deterministic, NO MODEL may appear in a precondition, and all prerequisites gate. Five admission verbs and five prohibitions. The armed set is a computed projection with no lifecycle and no writer: no component may prevent membership, and the admission authority holds no write access to precondition-bearing kinds. A trial interest is admissible only at the two lowest effect classes, may not declare a writer key, and may write only a proposed revision of a constraint. The unmatched pool is the computable complement, with retention exceeding the longest plausible outage and an alarm with a named reader — and its residue is named rather than covered: it cannot catch an entry that armed the WRONG interest. The admission authority gains a per-origin arming rate as a refusal predicate.","alternatives":["Rely on scheduled review alone, which is precisely this layer's removal criterion and the thing to test rather than assume","Let a model evaluate a precondition, refused: a false entry could then change what becomes due, and an untrusted entry may activate only read-only work","Allow a component to suppress an arming for throughput, refused: it makes a deferral invisible and returns the absence-versus-oversight ambiguity the layer exists to remove","Let a trial interest declare a writer key, refused by a deterministic admission check that names the failed predicate (R-D16)"],"evidence_and_reasoning":["planning/F2/05-selection-record.md#33-from-m5--when-work-becomes-due-layer-3","planning/F2/05-selection-record.md#51-the-synthesized-rules (R-L3, R-D15, R-D16, R-D23, R-X20, R-X21)","planning/F2/05-selection-record.md#13-evidence-ledger (rows 13-16: R5-01, R5-02, R3 F33, R8 B-7, AG-08, R1 F-10, F-11, R2 F-09, AS-M5-01)","research/F2/R5-routing.md","research/F2/R1-context.md (F-10: a no-instruction poisoning attack passed a four-stage screen 360 of 360)","planning/F2/reviews/A-security-adversarial.md (AS-M5-01, AS-M5-03, AS-M5-04)","planning/specification/05-work-agents-skills.md#7-durable-schedules-and-capacity-gaps (R-L3: StandingInterest, the armed set as a computed projection nobody writes, and the hard rules of layer 3)","planning/specification/05-work-agents-skills.md#9-positive-adverse-and-capacity-limited-conformance (row 5: an untrusted entry promoted to attested by the investigating activation)","planning/specification/05-work-agents-skills.md#10-registered-lifecycle-phases-named-only-in-the-registry (StandingInterest.trial)","planning/specification/11-schemas-state-contracts.md"],"epistemic_basis":"Source claim plus decision. Deterministic arming and the no-model precondition rest on R5-01, R5-02, R3 F33 and R8 B-7. The SPECIFIC five admission verbs and five prohibitions are a marked design proposal with no finding behind them (§13, row 14): the prohibitions are evidenced, the choice of five is not. The layer's admissibility turns on the deterministic-predicate fraction (U-6), which is unmeasured and is the layer's own sharpest falsifier. R-D15, the one rule this record cites that no specification text names by that id (F6A-11, 2026-09-14): both halves landed without the id. The no-promotion half is 05-work-agents-skills.md section 9, row 5 - an untrusted entry promoted to attested by the investigating activation is the adverse case, repaired by a new attested fact from an out-of-band corroborant. The trust-class prerequisite is section 7, cited there as \"D-15\". The floor half landed as an executable predicate under the id R-X13 in the contracts predicate registry, not as prose.","accepted_design_costs":["If the deterministic-predicate fraction is low, arming needs a model and this becomes the most expensive arrangement in the round — the response is withdrawal, not relaxation (R-X25)","The unmatched pool's residue is real and recorded as undetected: an entry that armed the wrong interest is not caught by it","The interest catalogue inherits the 10/100/1000 selection-degradation sweep, with one genuine advantage — near-duplicate typed predicates are statically detectable where near-duplicate prose descriptions are not"],"external_exposure_authorized":false,"reversibility":"Repository-local specification remains reversible; operational promises, disclosure and lost data require separate consequence decisions.","reopen_trigger":"Reopen when, over one month, every item whose relevance nobody currently holds in mind is surfaced within its latest responsible time by the existing scheduled review — then arming buys nothing. Withdraw the layer rather than relaxing it if the deterministic-predicate fraction falls below the threshold set under R-X25, whose value is a founder parameter and is open (§11.3, L3). Origin: F2 Step 5a-ii selection record §5.1 R-L3.","implementation_evidence":null,"source":"registers/decisions.json#/18","review_status":"Partially addressed","independent_review_note":"Source disposition preserved; no runtime or professional certification inferred. {"id":"AD-020","kind":"Decision","architecture_version":"S1.1","date":"2026-09-13","status":"adopted for the F2 amendment of 05-work-agents-skills.md; a selection, not complete-plan review, runtime conformance or founder acceptance","owner":"orchestrator under founder directive","title":"A worker exists only against a justification naming one reason, its unit and a test that can return false","problem":"Negative control 4 asks which frozen fixture exercises a persistent or standing structure, and specialized knowledge was the most-used reason for creating a worker in the round. A reason with no unit and no falsifiable test is rhetoric, and control 4 was never applied to two of the five candidates at all.","decision":"ExistenceJustification is one record per AgentInstance, written by C02 at admission and expiring with the instance. The proposed → admitted transition is REFUSED if the decidable test cannot return false. Specialized knowledge is refused as a reason and predicates on a skill version instead; provider or account separation folds into ExecutionSelection. Attributable identity is mandatory for every worker and is never a reason to create one. {"id":"AD-021","kind":"Decision","architecture_version":"S1.1","date":"2026-09-13","status":"adopted for the F2 amendment of 05-work-agents-skills.md; a selection, not complete-plan review, runtime conformance or founder acceptance","owner":"orchestrator under founder directive","title":"Standing accountability is a record with an address and a reservation; carried model memory is refused","problem":"A duty that outlives the case carrying it needs a party who is still there once the case is closed: a grievance six months after closure with the custodian implicated, a deletion scope whose clock runs after the case ends, a day-five incident at the terminus of an escalation ladder. The prohibition set is structural: a holder never produces, never releases, never decides the matter it is the subject of, and carries NO model memory. \"A holder prepares\" means an ephemeral worker instantiated under the holder's mandate carrying the holder's reservation ref and intake address and nothing else of the holder's. staffed → retired_into is refused while any duty it holds is live, and suspension stops admission in that duty class rather than leaving work assigned and silent. {"id":"AD-022","kind":"Decision","architecture_version":"S1.1","date":"2026-09-13","status":"adopted for the F2 amendment of 05-work-agents-skills.md; a selection, not complete-plan review, runtime conformance or founder acceptance","owner":"orchestrator under founder directive","title":"A reservation's minimum is evidence, not consent, and unconsumed allowance lapses independently of its holder","problem":"Two candidates ask the protected-lane holder before shedding and two apply a pre-endorsed order; the consolidation records opposite and individually correct positions with neither refuted, and two live blocking findings fail in OPPOSITE directions from that one question — nothing can halt a shed, and nothing can override a refusal. Separately, the session window resets on schedule whether consumed or not (R8 §3), so a reserve under a non-rolling allowance is waste rather than thrift, and no published denominator exists for expressing a reserve as an absolute quantity.","decision":"A protected-lane holder's stated minimum is EVIDENCE, never consent: there is no veto, and a returned minimum is recorded as evidence and does not block. Unconsumed reservation releases to the pool at a time-triggered lapse point independent of any holder's consent, with a declared cross-class release precedence and a lapsed-unconsumed record. Reservation gains holder_ref, stated_minimum and lapse_point; ShedDecision records the lane, the authority, the obligations that moved with named custodians, the stated minimum, whether it was breached, the overflow count and the lapsed-unconsumed quantity. Shares are fractions of the OBSERVED allowance, never absolute quantities. The exhaustion rule is distinct from the pressure rule: when the allowance is empty and a due obligation falls due, the named non-model production mode performs it, a named recipient is alerted, and the breach-or-perform decision leaves a record naming which was chosen and why.","alternatives":["Ask the holder and honour a refusal, which lets a holder hold an empty bucket hostage and is one of the two unrefuted positions","Execute a pre-endorsed order with no prohibition on refusal, which cannot notice that this particular shed is catastrophic — conceded in the workflow-first candidate's own words","Express reserves as absolute quantities, refused: no published denominator exists and every figure this round can produce is a ratio between arms","Let unconsumed reservation persist past the reset, refused: it is destroyed by the provider on schedule, so holding it is waste priced as thrift"],"evidence_and_reasoning":["planning/F2/05-selection-record.md#9-dissent-preserved (F-1, unresolved and retained)","planning/F2/05-selection-record.md#51-the-synthesized-rules (R-X24, R-G01, R-X10, R-X11)","planning/F2/05-selection-record.md#13-evidence-ledger (rows 24-26, 59: R8 §3, §8, W-6, MG-03, TC-26, AE-M4-01, AT and AE §E.2)","research/F2/R8-contrarian.md","planning/F2/reviews/A-economic-capacity.md (AE-M4-01)","planning/specification/07-integrations-capacity.md#6-capacity-money-and-scheduling"],"epistemic_basis":"Source claim and decision under a PRESERVED disagreement. The lapse rule rests on R8 §3; the no-veto rule on AE-M4-01 and R8 §8. The combination — a pre-endorsed order AND the no-veto prohibition — is the one neither pair of candidates proposed, and it is a choice under uncertainty rather than a resolution: whether a shed at the pressure threshold has time for a negotiation round has never been measured. The cross-class lapse PRECEDENCE ORDER is the selection record's own marked design proposal (§13, row 25). The lane shares, the stated minimums and the lapse point are a founder decision and no default is invented here.","accepted_design_costs":["A holder can be shed against its stated minimum, and the breach is what the founder is alerted to — the design accepts that it cannot notice that one particular shed is catastrophic","Generous reserves are destroyed unconsumed at the reset; tight reserves breach minimums under pressure. There is no setting that avoids both","The discriminating measurement is unrun, and the nearest instrument — one shed decision run twice on a tabletop — costs nothing and runs at the current pin"],"external_exposure_authorized":false,"reversibility":"Repository-local specification remains reversible; operational promises, disclosure and lost data require separate consequence decisions.","reopen_trigger":"Reopen on changed provider terms or semantics: the launch window, the concurrency pin, the cache lifetime, the metered affordance and the context-editing surface are provider properties, and a change to any of them moves this cost model (§11.1.4). Reopen the shed-authority half when the founder answers the halt-or-reverse packet, or when the shed tabletop is run and counts founder reversals against breached minimums. Origin: F2 Step 5a-ii selection record §9 dissent F-1, §5.1 R-X24.","implementation_evidence":null,"source":"registers/decisions.json#/21","review_status":"Partially addressed","independent_review_note":"Source disposition preserved; no runtime or professional certification inferred.
